第40章 王春晓赠披风，玉葫芦的变化-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“李青山，你等一下！”

就在李青山满心幻想着这次上山后大获丰收，将全家衣裳改善一下，想着王乃香和嫂子穿上裙子，露出一截白皙小腿的模样时，身后突然传来一道女人的声音。

李青山转身望去，来人正是王春晓。

大壮，二壮，赵红旗三人朝着李青山看了看，其中赵红旗十分懂事道：“山哥，我们先赶路，待会你追上来。”

“好！”李青山点了点头道。

“山哥，这个给你！”

王春晓说罢，便将手中的东西给李青山递了过去道。

“什么啊？”

李青山微微一怔，接过王春晓手中的东西打开，原本以为是什么衣服，接过打开才知道，竟然是一件黑色的披风，而且看材料极为不错，用料也柔软。

“这是我爹压箱子底的，当年到处都在打仗的时候他不知道从哪里捡回来的，我看他也不用，我就给找出来了，你上山肯定有不少刮刮蹭蹭，蚊虫鼠蚁什么的，而且老林子里面风也大，晚上也冷，带着它刚好合适。”

王春晓一脸关切道。

李青山望着手中的黑色披风，心中暗道，还真是小棉袄漏风了，这要是让春晓他爹知道了，还不得被气的吹胡子瞪眼，不过这黑色披风的材质确实很不错，看起来市面上并没有，过几日打猎回来后，给春晓他爹一些钱或者肉，就当自己买的便是了，否则自己这么穿着，春晓他爹肯定是会看到知晓的，这东西毕竟是春晓她爹的，不是春晓的。

打定主意后，李青山便将披风收了下来道：“行，那这披风我收下了，先走了。”

王春晓望着李青山的背影挥了挥手，眼眸中闪过一抹送情郎的深情。

黑色披风图

大壮，二壮和赵红旗三人，望着李青山身上的披风，脸上满是羡慕之色，就连前面的大黄也开始汪汪叫了起来，一行四人很快进了老林子，脸上便纷纷流露出一抹警惕之色。

“等这次回去，咱们去周边看看，能不能再寻两只猎狗，也给大黄找个伴！”

李青山走在最前面探路的大黄道。

上次上山砍出来的一条小路，如今已经再次被灌木和杂草长满，但是相比于上次，可是要好走许多，大壮手中拎着砍刀一边走一边开路，等到累的话，就让二壮和赵红旗轮番顶上，至于李青山要保存体力，万一路上要是遇到野物了呢？

清晨的老林子内，露水沾在青草的叶子上，尚未散去，晨曦顺着繁密林叶的空隙落在下方土地上，斑斑点点，宛若神秘世界逐渐复苏，精灵野怪开始穿梭在老林子内。

"Li Qingshan, wait a moment!"

Just when Li Qingshan was dreaming about the big harvest after going up the mountain, improving the clothes of the whole family, and thinking about Wang Naixiang and his sister-in-law putting on their skirts, revealing their white calves, a woman's voice suddenly came from behind.

Li Qingshan turned around and saw that the person coming was Wang Chunxiao.

Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang, and Zhao Hongqi looked at Li Qingshan. Among them, Zhao Hongqi said very sensibly: "Brother Shan, let's go on our way first. You can catch up later."

"Okay!" Li Qingshan nodded.

"Brother Shan, this is for you!"

After Wang Chunxiao said this, he handed the things in his hands to Li Qingshan and said.

"What?"

Li Qingshan was slightly startled. He took the thing in Wang Chunxiao's hand and opened it. He originally thought it was some kind of clothes, but after taking it, he realized that it was a black cloak. The material was very good and soft.

"My dad put this on the bottom of the box. He didn't know where he picked it up when there were wars everywhere. I saw that he didn't need it, so I found it. There must be a lot of scratches, mosquitoes, rats, ants, etc. when you go up the mountain. It's also windy in the old forest and cold at night, so it's just right to take it with you."

Wang Chunxiao said with concern.

Li Qingshan looked at the black cloak in his hand and thought to himself, the little cotton-padded jacket really leaked air. If Chunxiao's father found out about this, he would be so angry that he would blow his beard and stare. However, the material of this black cloak is indeed very good. It seems that there is no such thing on the market.No, after returning from hunting in a few days, give Chunxiao's father some money or meat and treat it as something you bought. Otherwise, Chunxiao's father will definitely see and know if you dress like this. After all, this thing belongs to Chunxiao's father, not Chunxiao.

After making up his mind, Li Qingshan took the cloak away and said, "Okay, I'll take the cloak and leave first."

Wang Chunxiao looked at Li Qingshan's back and waved, with a flash of deep affection for a lover in his eyes.

black cloak illustration

Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi looked at Li Qingshan's cloak with envy on their faces. Even Dahuang in front started barking. The group of four quickly entered the old forest, and their faces showed a look of vigilance.

"When we return this time, let's go see the surrounding area and see if we can find two more hunting dogs and find a companion for Dahuang!"

Li Qingshan walked at the forefront of the Dahuang Road to explore the road.

The path cut out last time up the mountain has now been overgrown with shrubs and weeds again, but compared to last time, it is much easier to walk. Da Zhuang holds the machete in his hand while walking and clearing the path. When he is tired, Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi will take turns to climb up. As for Li Qingshan, he needs to conserve his energy in case he encounters wild animals along the way.

In the old forest in the early morning, the dew has not yet dissipated on the leaves of the green grass. The morning sun falls on the land below through the gaps in the dense forest leaves, with spots, as if the mysterious world is gradually reviving, and elves and wild monsters have begun to shuttle through the old forest.
